'''Utoz''' was an [[Alcohol/Legends|alcoholic]] beverage produced from the [[Toz]] [[Grain/Legends|grain]] on [[Merisee/Legends|Merisee]] and many other planets of the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. [[Utozz Prime Brewery]] was the largest and oldest brewery on Merisee and produced a brand of Utoz called [[Utozz]].
